name: npc_kenshi-guard-01
customDialogue: The lake is calm. The gate is calm. Be calm.

name: npc_kenshi-villager-01
customDialogue:
I saw something in a broken stone once.
I still dream about it.

name: npc_kenshi-scholar-01
customDialogue:
Every duel since the founding is written here.
The last ten all mention tremors.

name: npc_kenshi-trainee-01
customDialogue:
Breathe in. Cut on the breath out.
Everything else is noise.

name: npc_kenshi-smith-01
customDialogue:
I scrape red off the blades every morning.
It comes back every night.

spotConfig.label: Look at the cut
spotConfig.text: In the deepest cut of the post runs a thin red line, as if the wood had bled metal.

spotConfig.label: Look at the cut
spotConfig.text: This post too. The red line follows the grain down into the ground.
